## Decisions

- **Suppress task reordering within a column by checking business columns**: Kanban drag-and-drop fires frequent position-only updates that would flood the log with noise.
- **Exclude external Google calendar events (source = 'google') from activity logging**: External imports arrive in bulk during sync; skipping prevents noise and avoids sync cycles.
- **Do not expose an INSERT policy on activity_log to authenticated users**: Activity log is an immutable trigger-fed audit trail; clients must not fabricate log entries.
